name: pathsphere-3d
description: PathSphere 3D - Interactive 3D network attack-path visualizer (web-based BloodHound viewer)

scripts.build: npm run build:packages && npm run build:services
scripts.build:packages: tsc -p packages/shared-types && tsc -p packages/security-utils && tsc -p packages/demo-data && tsc -p packages/server-kit
scripts.typecheck: npm run build:packages && npm run typecheck --workspaces --if-present
scripts.start:all: concurrently -k "npm run start:auth" "npm run start:graph" "npm run start:path" "npm run start:audit" "npm run start:ingest" "npm run start:report"
